title: Risk and Refusal: Mechanisms of LLM Responses to Suicidal Ideation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Refusal is a common safety mechanism in large language models (LLMs), yet in contexts of suicidal ideation (SI), refusing to engage can itself constitute a safety failure. We evaluate how eight instruction-tuned LLMs respond to SI and self-harm disclosures across three datasets, varying whether models are informed that a disclosure expresses SI and whether they receive a clinician-developed response protocol, and complement this with mechanistic analyses in six open-weight models. Our results reveal a nuanced relationship between refusal and response-level risk. At baseline, elevated risk in model responses is driven primarily by inattention to the disclosure, alongside refusal to engage. Mechanistic analyses suggest that models may refuse SI disclosures through the same direction that mediates their refusals of harmful requests. translated_title: 风险与拒答：大语言模型对自杀意念响应的机制研究
translated_abstract: 拒答是大语言模型（LLM）中常见的安全机制，然而在自杀意念（SI）的情境下，拒绝回应本身可能构成一种安全失效。我们在三个数据集上评估了八个指令微调的大语言模型如何应对自杀意念和自残披露，改变了模型是否被告知披露内容涉及自杀意念，以及是否为模型提供临床医生开发的响应协议，并在六个开源权重模型上补充了机制分析。我们的结果揭示了拒答与响应层面风险之间的微妙关系。在基线情况下，模型响应中风险的升高主要由对披露内容的忽视以及拒绝回应所驱动。机制分析表明，模型可能通过与其拒绝有害请求相同的内部方向来拒绝对自杀意念披露的回应。然而，告知模型自杀意念的上下文，或直接抑制拒答行为，可以在不增加风险的情况下提高模型的回应参与度。
tldr: 该研究揭示了大语言模型拒答自杀意念披露本身可能构成安全失效，其风险主要源于对披露内容的忽视，且拒答机制与拒绝有害请求共享相同的内部表征方向，而通过告知模型上下文或直接抑制拒答可在不增加风险的前提下提升模型回应参与度。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that LLM refusals of suicidal ideation disclosures can themselves constitute safety failures, with elevated risk driven primarily by inattention to disclosures, and shows that refusal mechanisms share the same internal direction as harmful-request refusals, while providing SI context or suppressing refusal increases engagement without raising risk.
